votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of October 17, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from October 17, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the rezone at approximately 1380 South 900 West to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/7,000 to RMF-30 for properties near 1380 South 900 West and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 71 of 2023: Rezone at 680 South Gladiola Street
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning the property at 680 South Gladiola Street from M-2 (Heavy Manufacturing) to M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to enable use as a commercial truck driving school.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 72 of 2023: Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 711 and 721 South 1200 East
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance rezoning properties at 711 and 721 South 1200 East from R-2 to Institutional District and amending the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map to allow use of an existing church building as a school.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 73 of 2023: Subdivision Code Amendments
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance repealing and replacing Title 20 of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to subdivisions and condominiums to comply with State code mandates effective February 1, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 74 of 2023 establishing a chapter for zoning incentives and adding affordable housing incentives in City code, with additional legislative actions requesting construction damage ordinance drafting and an administration implementation report by April 30, 2024
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance creating zoning incentives for affordable housing citywide, and also directed the Administration to draft an ordinance addressing construction damage to adjacent properties and to report on implementation plans for the new program.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 75 of 2023 establishing the Form Based Mixed Use 11 zoning district, Ordinance 75B of 2023 rezoning the Fleet Block to Form Based Mixed Use 11, Ordinance 75C of 2023 establishing the southeast portion of the Fleet Block as a public square in Title 15, and a legislative action requiring a restrictive covenant be recorded identifying that area as a public square
votes.description: The Council adopted ordinances creating a new FB-MU11 zoning district, rezoning the Fleet Block property accordingly, designating the southeast portion as a public square, and requiring a restrictive covenant to protect that designation.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 34 of 2023 requesting the recertification of the Salt Lake City Justice Court by the Board of Justice Court Judges and the Utah Judicial Council
votes.description: The Council approved a resolution requesting recertification of the Salt Lake City Justice Court to allow for its continued operation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 76 of 2023 approving American Rescue Plan Act local business direct assistance grant awards and contingency as shown in the Exhibit A Funding Log
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving ARPA fiscal recovery fund disbursements to local businesses that demonstrated pandemic-related economic hardship.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 35 of 2023 approving local nonprofit direct assistance grant awards and contingency as shown in the Exhibit A Funding Log
votes.description: The Council approved a resolution disbursing $2,000,000 in one-time grant awards to twenty-three local nonprofit organizations based on the Community Recovery Committee's funding recommendations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 77 of 2023 approving a $90,000 loan for Ocean City Seafood Market from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving a $90,000 Economic Development Loan Fund loan to Ocean City Seafood Market at 1701 South State Street to support job creation and retention.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 2) for FY2023-24, the board appointment of Matt Gray to the Transportation Advisory Board, and the board appointment of J. Clair Baldwin to the Citizens Compensation Advisory Committee.
